method: Correct full calendar month via product periodBounds. Actual old real/small A snapshot copied read-only; synthetic large/long parser output normalized in one batch for query-only replay. Synthetic root IDs bijectively prefixed with session ID to avoid cross-session title scans during bulk preparation; queried provider/session/model/time/token values unchanged. This preparation is not product W1. Same fact snapshot copied to A/B; correctness oracle and 9 query batches as before.

SELECT
      provider,
      model,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      NULLIF(local_day, '') AS period,
      SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
      SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(turn_count)
        THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens)
      END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens_known) = SUM(turn_count)
        THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens)
      END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
      SUM(turn_count) AS turn_count,
      SUM(completed_turns) AS completed_turns,
      SUM(recorded_turns) AS recorded_turns,
      SUM(recorded_completed_turns) AS recorded_completed_turns,
      1.0 * SUM(r_total_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
      1.0 * SUM(r_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0) AS avg_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(r_output_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0) AS avg_output_tokens,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(r_cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(recorded_completed_turns)
        THEN 1.0 * SUM(r_cache_write_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0)
      END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(r_cache_read_input_tokens_known) = SUM(recorded_completed_turns)
        THEN 1.0 * SUM(r_cache_read_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0)
      END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(r_duration_ms) / NULLIF(SUM(r_duration_ms_known), 0) AS avg_duration_ms,
      SUM(r_duration_ms_known) AS turns_with_duration,
      SUM(r_exact) AS exact_duration_turns,
      SUM(r_derived) AS derived_duration_turns,
      SUM(r_approximate) AS approximate_duration_turns,
      SUM(r_duration_missing) AS missing_duration_turns,
      SUM(unknown_time_turns) AS unknown_time_turns,
      SUM(stale_turns) AS stale_turns,
      MAX(last_successful_update) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (
      SELECT
      provider,
      project_key,
      session_id,
      local_day,
      model,
      model_key,
      input_tokens,
      output_tokens,
      total_tokens,
      turn_count,
      completed_turns,
      recorded_turns,
      recorded_completed_turns,
      cache_write_input_tokens,
      cache_write_input_tokens_known,
      cache_read_input_tokens,
      cache_read_input_tokens_known,
      c_input_tokens,
      c_output_tokens,
      c_total_tokens,
      c_cache_write_input_tokens,
      c_cache_write_input_tokens_known,
      c_cache_read_input_tokens,
      c_cache_read_input_tokens_known,
      c_duration_ms,
      c_duration_ms_known,
      c_exact,
      c_derived,
      c_approximate,
      c_duration_missing,
      r_input_tokens,
      r_output_tokens,
      r_total_tokens,
      r_cache_write_input_tokens,
      r_cache_write_input_tokens_known,
      r_cache_read_input_tokens,
      r_cache_read_input_tokens_known,
      r_duration_ms,
      r_duration_ms_known,
      r_exact,
      r_derived,
      r_approximate,
      r_duration_missing,
      unknown_time_turns,
      stale_turns,
      last_successful_update,
      min_started_at_ms
    FROM usage_model_daily AS turn_summary
    WHERE 1 = 1
      AND ((local_day <> '' AND local_day >= ? AND local_day < ?))
    ) AS turn_summary
    GROUP BY provider, model, period
    ORDER BY (period IS NULL OR coalesce(model, '') = ''), period IS NULL, coalesce(model, '') = '', provider, model, period
    LIMIT ?
    OFFSET ?

SELECT
      provider,
      model,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      agent_tracker_period(started_at_ms, ?, ?) AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.id,
      t.provider,
      t.project_key,
      t.session_id,
      t.root_turn_id,
      t.request_title,
      coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
      t.started_at_ms,
      t.completed_at_ms,
      t.duration_ms,
      t.duration_quality,
      t.status,
      t.quality_flags,
      t.diagnostic_file_id,
      t.diagnostic_offset,
      t.last_error,
      t.updated_at,
      CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = ''
    AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0
  THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
      
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens
  END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens
  END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
    FROM turn_summary t
    LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
    
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE (started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?)
    GROUP BY provider, model, period
    ORDER BY (period IS NULL OR coalesce(model, '') = ''), period IS NULL, coalesce(model, '') = '', provider, model, period
    LIMIT ?
    OFFSET ?

    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)

    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)

      WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.id,
      t.provider,
      t.project_key,
      t.session_id,
      t.root_turn_id,
      t.request_title,
      coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
      t.started_at_ms,
      t.completed_at_ms,
      t.duration_ms,
      t.duration_quality,
      t.status,
      t.quality_flags,
      t.diagnostic_file_id,
      t.diagnostic_offset,
      t.last_error,
      t.updated_at,
      CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = ''
    AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0
  THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
      
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens
  END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens
  END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
    FROM turn_summary t
    LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
    
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE project_key = ? AND started_at_ms IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY provider, model, period, session_id
    ORDER BY (period IS NULL OR coalesce(model, '') = ''), period IS NULL, coalesce(model, '') = '', provider, model, period
    LIMIT ?
    OFFSET ?
